prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there’s no single “best” AI video ad maker — the right one depends on your goals (platform, format, budget, need for AI presenters or repurposing). Below are the top options by use-case and what each does best, plus tips to choose.

Top choices (by use-case)
- Synthesia — Best for AI spokesperson/voice & multilingual ads. High-quality virtual presenters and fast script→video. Good for product demos, training, and polished talking-head ads. Enterprise/paid.
- HeyGen (Movio-style alternatives) — Strong Synthesia competitor; realistic avatars, expressive speech. Good if you want a human-like presenter without filming.
- Pictory — Best for turning long-form content into short social ads and automated captioning. Good for repurposing webinars, podcasts, and blog posts.
- InVideo — Fast template-driven ad creator with many social templates and easy editing. Affordable and good for small businesses making multiple variations.
- Canva — Best all-around for simple ad creation, brand kits, and social templates; now has AI video features and integrates design + video in one tool.
- Opus Clip — Best for automatic short-form, vertical ad clips (TikTok/Reels) from longer videos using AI highlights.
- Descript — Best for transcript-driven editing, natural-sounding overdubs (Overdub), and fast edits — ideal if you do a lot of speaking-based content.
- Runway — Best for advanced generative/video-edit effects and creative ads (green-screen removal, generative fill). More pro-oriented.

How to pick
- Platform/format: vertical (TikTok/Reels) → Opus Clip/InVideo/Canva; horizontal (YouTube) → Pictory/Descript/Runway.
- Creative type: need AI presenter → Synthesia/HeyGen; repurposing long content → Pictory/Opus Clip; advanced VFX → Runway.
- Speed vs control: templates (fast) → InVideo/Canva; bespoke control (slower) → Descript/Runway.
- Budget: Canva/InVideo/Pictory have affordable tiers; Synthesia/Runway tend to be pricier for enterprise features.
- Localization: choose tools with multi-language voice/avatars (Synthesia, HeyGen).

Quick tips
- Make multiple variants (lengths, hooks) for A/B testing.
- Export with platform-appropriate aspect ratios and captions.
- Check licensing for stock media and voice/avatar commercial use.

If you tell me: target platform (Facebook/Instagram/TikTok/YouTube), budget, whether you need a human-like presenter, and whether you’ll repurpose long content, I’ll recommend the single best tool and a quick workflow for your ad.
